definitions.gloss: delivery time; delivery hours; delivery window
definitions.explanation: The time or time period during which a delivery is made or scheduled to arrive.

examples.japanese: {配達時間|はいたつじかん}を{指定|してい}できますか。
examples.english: Can I specify a delivery time?

examples.japanese: {配達時間|はいたつじかん}は{午前中|ごぜんちゅう}を{希望|きぼう}します。
examples.english: I'd like the delivery time to be in the morning.

examples.japanese: {不在|ふざい}だったので{配達時間|はいたつじかん}を{変更|へんこう}して、{夜|よる}の{時間帯|じかんたい}に{届|とど}けてもらった。
examples.english: Since I wasn't home, I changed the delivery time and had it delivered in the evening.

notes:
A compound of {配達|はいたつ} (delivery) and {時間|じかん} (time). This is an everyday term used when ordering packages, food delivery, or scheduling any kind of delivery service.

In Japan, parcel delivery services ({宅配便|たくはいびん}) such as ヤマト{運輸|うんゆ} and {佐川急便|さがわきゅうびん} allow customers to specify {配達時間|はいたつじかん}{帯|たい} (delivery time slots), typically in 2-hour windows.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {配達時間|はいたつじかん}を{指定|してい}する: to specify a delivery time
- {配達時間|はいたつじかん}を{変更|へんこう}する: to change the delivery time
- {配達時間|はいたつじかん}{帯|たい}: delivery time slot/window
- {配達時間|はいたつじかん}{外|がい}: outside delivery hours

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {配送|はいそう}{日|び}: delivery date — the calendar date of delivery
- {到着|とうちゃく}{予定|よてい}{時刻|じこく}: estimated time of arrival — more precise, used for tracking
- {受|う}け{取|と}り{時間|じかん}: pick-up time, receiving time — the time one collects a package
